0.q: when the EkFLS gene was over-expressed in Arabidopsis thaliana, the accumulation of flavonoids was improved.

1.q: EkFLS overexpressed Arabidopsis promoted stomatal aperture to influence photosynthesis of the plants, which in turn can promote stress resistance.

2.q: EkFLS, a key enzyme in the synthesis of flavonols, was cloned from E. kansui... EkFLS plays a pivotal role in the synthesis of flavonols.
